title: Frequency Counter
description: Write a Zig program that counts the frequency of each character in a string and prints non-zero counts.
verificationTest: output.includes('h:1') && output.includes('e:1') && output.includes('l:3') && output.includes('o:2') && output.includes('w:1') && output.includes('r:1') && output.includes('d:1')
hints: Use an array of 256 u32 values indexed by ASCII code
Iterate twice: once to count, once to print non-zero counts
Reset freq to 0 after printing to avoid duplicates
